minimal_pack.state_after_removing_last_byte: no valid head: no commit was ever completed; malformed (section 2.3, step 3)

pinned.what: two objects whose `from.sources` are pins (sections 4.4, 5.3), and the state of each pin at each commit where the object is present. A pin is current where its digest, computed again, is the one it holds

pins: the text, from before element (c1, 0) to after (c1, 6): 'Hello, '
the text, from before (c1, 7) to after (c1, 14): 'universe'
why: 'Hello, ' is never edited, and its one span still touches it
the word is replaced at the second commit: every element the region covered is removed
the face's medium is set at the second commit, and the text it refers to changes at the second and third

commits.note: its object map has an interior node; one node frame and three chunk frames use codec 1; two properties are kept outside their nodes: the asset's bytes and one item's long
the asset is dropped: absent from this map, present in the previous one

history_pack.where_to_find: the text is property chars of the text object; its span is spans.p1.at; the blob is property bytes of the asset; the clock's axis t has extent [start, end]

blob.note: the asset's bytes property is an indirect of kind b to this blob; the same blob is named from the operation that set it, inside the change's work

history_pack.heads: four head frames: after commit 1, after commit 2, after the seal (naming commit 2 again), after commit 3; each gives the offset of the one before
history_pack.indexes: two in the final chain: the one written with commit 3, and before it one covering commits 1 and 2, which absorbed the first by the merge rule

recovery.writer: no valid head in the tail: truncate
the seal's head is torn: truncate; the seal frame is lost

anchors_resolved_at_commit_3.note: ends after the full stop: what was typed after it is outside
a point at a removed element: still attached

resolve_continuous.note: it only touches an end of the extent: that point

merge_readiness.note: each line is [change, number, character, removed]; the three results are equal

printer.behaviour: sum_to(4) returns 10 and leaves the global at 10; add(2, 3) returns 5
notes: types in order of first use; exports in the order of their keys in the encoded map (add, memory, sum_to)
a bare name is local.get of a local or parameter, else global.get; a bare integer is i32.const
the body of sum_to has one run of locals: one i32

instrumentation.name: add: one entry region of 4 instructions
instrumentation.behaviour: with ufo:fuel = 4, add(2, 3) returns 5 and leaves 0; with ufo:fuel = 3 it traps out of fuel

instrumentation.name: spin: entry region of 2 (loop, final end), loop region of 6
instrumentation.behaviour: spin(3) consumes 2 + 3*6 = 20; with ufo:fuel = 19 it traps out of fuel on entering the third iteration

digests.pin: the text of history.ufx at its last commit, the region from before element (c1, 0) to after element (c1, 6)
digests.note: the covered items are 'Hello, '; the one span touches them; an anchor inside a span is not followed

digests.pin: the face object of history.ufx at its last commit, whole
digests.note: the face refers to the text, so the text's identity and current revision hash follow the covered value

nested.nested.ufx: whole. The commit the anchor names is present, so the other universe is nested and each of its records is reachable through the anchor (section 1.3); compaction keeps them. The Portal presents the text 'Nested.'
nested.linked.ufx: whole. The same universe, with the same root hash; the commit the anchor names is not in the file, so the other universe is linked. The Portal's target is unavailable and the reader shows its label (O4). Nothing is malformed.
nested.plain_text_face_of_nested.ufx:
A note from another universe:
> Nested.

published.what: history.ufx as it is published: the content and attribution layers, the seal, and an absent frame saying that working history is withheld. Working history is every other record of history.ufx
published.content_is: the nodes of the current object map, and the current revisions of the universe object, the face and the text. The clock and the forty items are not reachable from the universe object, so they are not live
published.attribution_is: the three commit nodes and the three change objects. Each change's work, and the opening of its veil, are working history

a_reader_of_published.ufx.can: verify the commit chain and the seal; find and read every live object; resolve every anchor; say which change wrote each character and its origin
a_reader_of_published.ufx.cannot: replay any change: every work is withheld, and it reports them as withheld (E11), not as missing

timeline.what: a clock whose t is a count: ten seconds inserted by one change; then two seconds cut from the middle; then one second inserted by another change; then the first second of play b cut. Positions and times are in flicks

plays.a: seconds 0 to 6 as first inserted, playing the first take from its time 0
plays.b: from second 6 to the end, playing the second take from its time 2 s

anchors.m1: second 4: cut in commit 2, so detached from then on
anchors.m2: second 8: moves two seconds earlier after the cut, and one later after the insertion
anchors.m3: seconds 1 to 5: shortened by the cut

timeline.rule: a play's region begins at the boundary [c, n, side]; n0 is n + side, read from the anchor whether or not those elements are still present. At an element numbered m by the same change c inside the region, the play's object is at time offset + (m - n0); at an element of another change it is not present

compose_pack.what: one text holding a heading, a paragraph with emphasis and strong, bulleted items with two numbered items nested, a quote, code with a line break, a second heading, six paragraphs and an empty last paragraph; a document face and a face of pages 320 by 400 with margins of 24

pins.what: one commit holding a text with an empty block and an inline span, three small objects that refer to one another, an asset of sixteen bytes, a clock from second 2 to second 8, and an object whose `marks` holds an anchor of every kind
pins.extents: the asset's bytes: [0, 16]. The clock's t: [start, end] = [2 s, 8 s]. The object named by `unknown` is of a type this document does not define, so its axis w has no known extent

digests.why: the spans that share a present element with the passage are kept: b0, b2 and i0. The empty block b1 is a point and shares none; b3 lies outside. The ref in i0 is followed to x; x's `of` is followed to y; y refers back to the text, which is the pinned object and is never followed; the anchor in `href` is not a ref and not an `of`, and is not followed
a point covers nothing and nothing touches it: the covered items are empty and the map is there, empty

digests.case: a whole object with a snapshot
digests.why: a property named snapshot is left out of the covered value
the entries of the keys that are present, and nothing for the key that is not
the covered value is the object's properties whole; both children are followed, whatever their intervals
continuous: the covered value is the asset's properties, with the bytes themselves
on a count the covered items are the runs the region covers, cut to it; play a touches them and plays b and c do not; the first take is followed

published_timeline.content_is: the current object map; the universe object, the clock, the two takes and the caption. The object holding the marks is not reachable from the universe object and is not live
published_timeline.attribution_is: the four commits; the changes d4, d6 and d7, which the clock's current revision names in `by` or in a run of `seq`. The change d5 only removed elements, so nothing present names it: it is working history, and its revision is withheld although its commit names it

a_reader_of_the_published_copy.can: resolve every play and say what plays at every position, exactly as from the whole pack
a_reader_of_the_published_copy.reports: the revision of change d5 as withheld, not as damage: a commit's change may be absent where the change is not attributing (section 2.5)

published_nested.content_is: the outer universe's object map and its three live objects; and, because a live Portal's anchor names a commit that is present, the nested universe's object map, its universe object and its text
published_nested.attribution_is: both commits and both changes: the outer one, and the nested universe's own, so that who wrote the nested text can be said

a_reader_of_the_published_copy.can: say who wrote 'Nested.': the change d1 of the nested universe, witnessed, by a person, Test Author

tools_pack.what: a minimal tools universe: one line of five words, each under a span whose `on.press` handler sets presentation state (which face; whether editing) or acts (export). It names no universe: a reader presents it with the universe being worked on as its subject
